name: Storyworld
status: Operative form for strategic media and audience encounters
governing_object: Turn strategic purpose into repeatable audience encounters that can produce useful media, meet real viewers, and return earned learning to the channel.
entry_sequence: Purpose -> Audience -> Promise -> Pillar -> Material -> Format -> Contact

world_laws.formats: Movable carriers (interview, game, demonstration, challenge, exchange, profile, short), not strategy
world_laws.focus: One lead audience. One lead promise. One lead pillar. Secondary connections must be earned.
world_laws.story: Movement driven by question, choice, attempt, tension, discovery, surprise or change -> payoff
world_laws.reality: Reality chooses the finished piece. A planned pillar does not obligate weak material to become a video.

encounter: Find strongest available person x material x audience relevance x strategic connection. Shape smallest complete story. Design complete YouTube episode first, derive Shorts/social expressions afterward.

contact.rule: Never infer a downstream consequence from an upstream proxy. Record production cost and reusable material.

return: Carry home only what contact earned. Series earns persistence when audience + recurring promise + repeatable encounter survive multiple contacts.
prime: Enter through purpose. Find the human encounter. Give the audience a reason to care. Let the material determine the story. Let the audience answer. Bring back only what was earned.
